No. He did not tell the agent to cancel or cut tests. After I had cut them, he said: "Btw I never said u shoukd cancel tests etc...", "I'm just against useless tests", and objected to "repeating the same ci cd process multiple times for no reason".

His earlier words to a4e27882 were: "I will not accept such long and wasteful ci cd processes any longer!" I misread that as permission to cut tests, admitted the misreading, and began restoring the cut tests.

The rule now reads "No useless tests; no repeated runs." It means one run per check per tree, with useless tests removed only through the delegates "Run each check once per tree" (35d1777c) and "Remove useless tests" (8a22907f). The second leaves webkit-caw and across-update in place.
